text: A new job. A new city. A place to call home. For Arjun, moving to Bengaluru was the beginning of something exciting.
He finds the perfect apartment. The rent is twenty-five thousand rupees a month. But there's one problem. The landlord asks for a one lakh rupee security deposit, upfront.
Arjun can afford his monthly rent. But paying a large deposit all at once means draining his savings, delaying his move, or borrowing from someone else.
What if renting a home came with a smarter way to manage the money behind it? Introducing Velora. A financial platform built around the renting experience.

Through Velora, eligible tenants can apply for security deposit financing through regulated lending partners. Instead of paying the entire amount upfront, they can explore a structured repayment plan that fits their financial situation.
And it doesn't stop there. Manage recurring rent payments, keep digital payment records, and access landlord protection options through insurance partners.
Now, Arjun can focus on settling into his new home, while managing his rental finances with greater clarity and confidence.
Velora. Making the financial side of renting simpler.

Finding a home is just the beginning. Once you move in, a new journey begins. Managing rent every month. Planning your finances. Staying connected with your landlord. Keeping track of important rental information. And making sure the people involved in renting have greater clarity and confidence. Because renting a home shouldn't mean managing a hundred different things separately. It should work together. That's where Velora comes in.

Sometimes, the challenge isn't whether you can afford your rent. It's when the money becomes available. Imagine your rent is due before your salary arrives. You know your income is coming. You know you can manage your monthly expenses. But the timing doesn't always work in your favour. And when rent is due, even a temporary cash-flow gap can create unnecessary pressure.

Introducing Velora Flex. A rent financing solution designed to help eligible tenants manage temporary cash-flow gaps. Through regulated lending partners, tenants can explore financing options that help them manage an upcoming rent payment without having to rely entirely on their immediate available balance.

The process is designed to be straightforward. First, explore the available financing option. Next, submit the required information and complete the application. The regulated lending partner then performs the necessary verification and credit assessment. If approved, the financing is provided according to the lender's terms. You can review the repayment schedule, understand your obligations and plan ahead.

Velora Flex helps eligible tenants navigate temporary financial timing gaps with a more structured financing option. Because financial flexibility isn't about avoiding responsibility. It's about having options when timing matters.

Rent is one of the most important recurring expenses. But managing it every month can become another task to remember. Remembering the due date. Making the payment. Sharing confirmation. Finding the receipt later. And sometimes, even after paying, you still need to search through messages to find the proof.

Introducing Velora Pay. A simpler way to manage recurring rent payments. With Velora Pay, tenants can choose how they want to manage their monthly rent. Whether they prefer an automatic recurring payment setup or want to make each payment manually, the experience keeps their rental payments organised.

For tenants who prefer automation, Velora Pay offers an automatic recurring payment option through supported payment arrangements. After reviewing the details and providing the required authorization, tenants can set up a recurring payment instruction. Once configured, payments can be initiated according to the authorized schedule and applicable payment conditions. And when a payment is successfully confirmed by the payment provider, the status is updated.

Prefer to stay in control of every payment? You can choose manual payments instead. Velora Pay can send timely reminders before rent is due. When you're ready, open the payment details, review the amount and complete the payment through the supported payment method. The payment status is updated once the transaction is confirmed.

And every confirmed payment becomes part of an organised rental payment history. Access payment records. View digital receipts. Keep important payment information together. No more searching through old conversations just to find a payment confirmation.
From recurring payment arrangements to timely reminders and accessible payment records, Velora Pay makes the monthly rent routine easier to manage.

Renting involves more than just two people and one payment. Tenants need access to their rental information. Landlords need visibility into their properties and rental records. Property managers need a clearer way to coordinate information and manage multiple tenancies. But when everything is spread across messages, documents and separate tools, keeping track of the complete rental experience becomes difficult.

Introducing Velora Hub. A connected rental management experience designed to bring tenants, landlords and property managers closer together. Instead of managing important rental information across disconnected places, Velora Hub brings supported rental details and records into one organised experience.

For tenants, Velora Hub provides a central place to access important rental information. View your rental overview. Review property and tenancy details. Access payment records and receipts. And stay informed about important updates related to your rental experience.

For landlords, it offers a more organised way to manage rental information. Review relevant property and tenancy details. Access available rental payment records. And maintain better visibility into the information associated with their properties.

And for property managers, Velora Hub provides a connected view of the rental information they need to coordinate. Whether managing one property or multiple tenancies, the goal is to make important rental information easier to access, organise and manage.

Different people. Different responsibilities. One connected rental experience. With the right information available to the right people, managing the rental relationship can become more organised and transparent.

For landlords, rental income is an important part of managing a property. It may help cover loan commitments, maintenance expenses and other ongoing obligations. But rental income can sometimes become uncertain. A delayed payment or an eligible rental default can create financial pressure. And landlords need ways to understand and manage these risks.

Introducing Velora Protect. A way for landlords to explore insurance-backed rent protection options through authorised insurance partners. It brings relevant protection options into the rental ecosystem, helping landlords understand available coverage and make informed decisions.

The journey begins by exploring available protection options. Landlords can review the coverage being offered, understand the eligibility requirements and examine the applicable exclusions and conditions. When they choose to proceed, the application follows the authorised insurance partner's process. The insurer evaluates the application according to its underwriting requirements. If the policy is approved and issued, the landlord receives the relevant policy details and documentation.

Most importantly, protection begins with understanding what is actually covered. Every policy has defined coverage limits, eligibility requirements, exclusions and conditions. If a covered event occurs, the landlord can follow the insurer's claims process. The insurer evaluates the claim based on the policy terms and supporting documentation.

Velora Protect helps landlords explore relevant insurance-backed options and understand how protection may fit into their rental management approach. Because confidence comes from knowing your options and understanding the conditions behind them.

Every rental journey is different. A tenant may need flexibility when rent arrives before payday. They may want a simpler way to manage monthly payments. Landlords and property managers may need better access to rental information. And landlords may want to explore protection against eligible rental risks. That's why Velora brings these experiences together. With Velora Flex, tenants can explore rent financing options. With Velora Pay, they can manage recurring rent payments. With Velora Hub, tenants, landlords and property managers can access a more connected rental management experience. And with Velora Protect, landlords can explore insurance-backed rent protection options through authorised partners.

Renting is one of life's most important financial commitments. It deserves an experience that is clearer, more connected and easier to manage. From financial flexibility to monthly payments, rental management and protection options. Velora is building the financial layer of renting. Helping tenants, landlords and property managers move forward with greater confidence. Velora. Move forward with confidence.
